name: kontora
description: Kontora — B2B SaaS invoicing & client-management platform (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=db && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=api && npm run lint --workspace=db && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.db:migrate:docker: docker compose run --rm migrate migrate dev
scripts.db:seed:docker: docker compose run --rm migrate db seed
